finding.summary: The account popover had a broad avatar control and Profile was mentioned as an indirect navigation route, but its three actionable menu entries were not individually represented in the navigation control list.

source_references.evidence: Profile is gated by the Profile audience; Preferences is gated by Settings audience and both menu items call goto.
Sign out is rendered unconditionally, closes the popover, and invokes signOut.
Profile is signed-in only; Settings is available to everyone.
Prior control list ended at C08 and case list at T18; existing C01 noted Profile navigation but did not separately enumerate menu actions.

coverage_limits: Source mapping only; no browser, product, role, persistence or accessibility behavior was observed.
Guest/member/admin feature cells remain unverified. The nine new role-specific cases have no results or run IDs.
Case steps describe future UI checks and do not establish auth sign-out success, view rendering, menu dismissal, or actual role visibility.
